def signed_token_generator(private_pem, **kwargs):
    def generator(request, refresh_token=False):
        claims = {
            'scope': ' '.join(request.scopes) if request.scopes else '',
            'user_id': request.user_id if hasattr(request, 'user_id') else (
                request.user if hasattr(request, 'user') else None
